## Scoring / Victory Conditions

**30 VP:** First to 30 wins immediately, on any player's turn. If multiple reach 30 simultaneously, tied player closest clockwise to current player wins, including current player. Removing enemy buildings/tokens gives one VP each regardless of phase or whether attacker/defender. Crafting items scores printed VP except Eyrie's Disdain. Faction scoring is described above.
